newsitem.title: USA: America West to cut fares up to 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: America West to cut fares up to 20 pct.

text.p: America West Airlines on Monday announced fares as much as 20 percent less than current fare sales advertised by full-service competitors.
The company said fares begin as low as $39 each way with coast-to-coast trips starting at $149 each way.

Tickets must be purchased within 72 hours of making reservations and no later than February 7, the company said. Travel can begin as early as February 3 and must be completed by June 14, America West said.
